groups.title: Residential
groups.summary: Licensed, friendly electricians for Houston homes, from lighting refreshes to full rewiring.
groups.intro: Your home deserves the same precision and care as any high-end project. Electrical Masters Company brings licensed, friendly electricians into Houston homes for everything from lighting refreshes to full rewiring, always treating your space like our own. Our master electricians pull the proper permits, work clean, and leave your home better than they found it.

services.title: Electrical Panel and Breaker Upgrades
services.text: Many Houston homes are still running the service panel they were built with, and air conditioning, EV charging, induction ranges, tankless water heaters, pool equipment and home offices place demands on that panel no one anticipated.
points: Warning signs: breakers that trip under normal use, lights that dim when a large appliance starts, warm cover plates, a burning smell, or a panel with no space left to add a circuit
We inspect what is actually in the home and tell you whether a repair, a sub-panel or a full service upgrade is the honest answer
We handle the utility coordination, permitting and inspection that a service change requires

services.title: Whole-Home and Standby Generator Installation
services.text: A permanently installed standby generator sits outside the home like a condenser unit, monitors utility power, and starts automatically within seconds of an outage.
points: We size the unit to what the home actually needs rather than selling the largest model on the shelf
The install includes the automatic transfer switch, a code-compliant gas supply, the pad, bonding and grounding, permitting and inspection, and a commissioning test under real load
We register the equipment so the manufacturer warranty starts clean
Generac standby systems installed for homes and businesses

services.title: EV Charger Installation
services.text: Most Houston EV owners move to a Level 2 charger on a dedicated 240-volt circuit and recover a full battery overnight. The part that needs an electrician's judgment is whether the existing service can carry the new load.
points: We perform a load calculation before quoting, not after
A dedicated circuit with the correct breaker, conductor size and GFCI protection for the location
Garage, carport and outdoor installations each carry different requirements for conduit, weather rating and mounting height
Hardwired or plug-in options, charger placement and permitting

services.title: Rewiring, Circuits and Remodel Electrical
services.text: Older Houston housing stock often hides cloth-insulated wiring, ungrounded two-prong outlets, aluminium branch circuits, or a decade of undocumented handyman work behind the drywall.
points: Whole-home rewiring is disruptive and we do not recommend it lightly
Partial rewires, dedicated circuits for heavy appliances and grounding corrections solve most problems without gutting the house
For remodels and additions we lay out circuits, lighting and device locations against how the room will actually be used

services.title: Lighting Upgrades, Outdoor Lighting and Fan Installation
services.text: Upgrade old lighting to hot trending dimmers, make your home look inviting with outdoor lighting fixtures, and stay cool in summer with a decorative fan installed by our electrical team.
points: Recessed lighting, chandeliers, accent lighting and outdoor lighting, designed and installed to enhance both function and aesthetics
Outlets with USB, behind the wall wiring and more
Electrical design for a home that is getting older and where repairs are inevitable

services.title: Electrical Safety Inspections
services.text: A safety inspection is worth booking when you are buying or selling a home, after major storm or flood exposure, when an insurer asks, or when a house has never had its electrical system properly looked at.
points: We check the panel and breakers, grounding and bonding, GFCI and AFCI protection in the locations code requires, outlet polarity, visible wiring condition and smoke alarm placement
A written summary separating genuine safety issues from things that are merely dated

services.title: Electrical Repair and Installation
services.text: From troubleshooting a tripping breaker to installing new circuits, lighting and equipment, Electrical Masters Company delivers reliable electrical repair and installation across Houston, TX. We diagnose the real problem and fix it right the first time.
points: Circuit breaker installation and panel repair
Outlet, switch and wiring repair, plus outlet and switch relocation
Lighting installation, indoor and outdoor, and light fixture installation
Dedicated circuits and equipment hookups
Common repairs include tripping breakers, flickering lights, dead outlets and switches, aluminum-wiring corrections, loose or scorched connections, and grounding problems
We repair rather than replace whenever it is safe and cost-effective, and we always tell you which is which
24/7 emergency electrical repair

faqs.q: How do I know if my home needs an electrical panel upgrade?
faqs.a: If you're experiencing frequent breaker trips, flickering lights, or adding major appliances (EV charger, HVAC, etc.), your panel may be outdated or overloaded.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit for electrical work?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. We handle all permits and coordinate with the City of Houston to ensure full compliance.

faqs.q: Why does my breaker keep tripping?
faqs.a: This usually means the circuit is overloaded or there's a fault. It's a safety feature, but one that should be evaluated.

faqs.q: Do you install whole-home generators?
faqs.a: Yes, we install generators (including Generac systems) to keep your home powered during outages and storms.

faqs.q: Do you install EV chargers at home?
faqs.a: Yes, we specialize in EV charger installations, including load calculations and panel upgrades to ensure safe, code-compliant operation.

faqs.q: Can you handle high-voltage systems?
faqs.a: Yes, Electrical Masters Company is fully equipped to handle high-voltage electrical systems for industrial and commercial facilities, including warehouses, distribution centers, and manufacturing environments. We specialize in working with complex, high-demand power systems, including panel upgrades, switchgear, transformers, and large-scale power distribution.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to rewire a home?
faqs.a: Costs vary based on size, age, and scope. We provide detailed, transparent estimates after an on-site evaluation.

faqs.q: Do you offer emergency electrical services?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide fast-response service for urgent residential electrical issues.

faqs.q: How do you ensure OSHA and safety compliance?
faqs.a: We follow strict OSHA standards and implement safety-first protocols on every job site.

faqs.q: Do you offer ongoing maintenance services?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide maintenance and service agreements to prevent downtime and costly repairs.

faqs.q: Why are my lights flickering?
faqs.a: Flickering lights can indicate loose wiring, overloaded circuits, or panel issues. It's important to have this inspected promptly to avoid safety risks.

faqs.q: Can you help with lighting design?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We design and install recessed lighting, chandeliers, accent lighting, and outdoor lighting to enhance both function and aesthetics.

faqs.q: Is it safe to live in a home with outdated wiring?
faqs.a: Older wiring (like aluminum or knob-and-tube) can pose fire risks. An inspection can determine if upgrades are needed.

faqs.q: Will a Level 2 EV charger require a panel upgrade?
faqs.a: Not always. It depends on your existing service size and current load. We run the calculation before quoting so the answer is known before work begins.

faqs.q: How long does EV charger installation take?
faqs.a: Most residential installations can be completed within a few hours, depending on the complexity of the electrical system and whether upgrades are needed.

faqs.q: Can I install an EV charger outside my home?
faqs.a: Yes. Many EV chargers are designed for outdoor installation and are built to withstand weather conditions when properly installed.

faqs.q: How long does a standby generator installation take?
faqs.a: The on-site electrical and gas work is typically completed in a few days once equipment is on hand, but permitting, utility or gas coordination, and inspection scheduling extend the overall timeline. We give you a realistic schedule up front rather than an optimistic one.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit for residential electrical work?
faqs.a: Panel changes, service upgrades, new circuits, generator installations, and EV charger circuits generally require a permit and inspection in the City of Houston and surrounding jurisdictions. We pull permits as part of the job.

faqs.q: Can you handle electrical work for new commercial builds?
faqs.a: Yes, we manage full electrical scope from design to final inspection for offices, retail, and mixed-use spaces. We work with property managers, owners and investors.

faqs.q: How do you ensure projects stay on schedule?
faqs.a: We coordinate closely with contractors, inspectors, and project managers to meet strict deadlines, especially for openings.

faqs.q: Do you handle permits and inspections?
faqs.a: Yes, we manage the entire permitting process and work directly with local inspectors to ensure compliance.

faqs.q: What types of commercial clients do you serve?
faqs.a: We work with developers, property owners, general contractors, and business owners across multiple industries.

faqs.q: Can you upgrade electrical systems for an existing business?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We specialize in panel upgrades, system expansions, and bringing properties up to current code.

faqs.q: Do you install emergency and exit lighting?
faqs.a: Yes, code-compliant emergency and exit lighting is a core part of our commercial services.

faqs.q: What are signs a commercial property needs an upgrade?
faqs.a: Frequent outages, outdated panels, increased equipment demand, or failing inspections are all indicators.

faqs.q: Can you help reduce energy costs?
faqs.a: We offer energy-efficient lighting upgrades and system optimization to lower operating expenses.

faqs.q: How quickly can you mobilize on a project?
faqs.a: We're known for rapid mobilization, especially for time-sensitive commercial openings.

faqs.q: Do you work on warehouses and industrial facilities?
faqs.a: Yes, industrial electrical is one of our specialties, including warehouses, plants, distribution and data centers.

faqs.q: What services do you offer for industrial clients?
faqs.a: We handle everything from high-capacity panel upgrades and power distribution systems to equipment and machinery wiring, high-bay and exterior safety lighting, and full-scale facility build-outs.

faqs.q: Can you help get a facility ready for inspection quickly?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We step in immediately to identify what's wrong, fix it fast, and get you across the finish line.

faqs.q: Do you install industrial lighting systems?
faqs.a: Yes, high-bay lighting, exterior safety lighting, and energy-efficient upgrades are all part of our services.

faqs.q: What causes unexpected power loss in industrial settings?
faqs.a: Common causes include overloaded systems, faulty equipment, or aging infrastructure.

faqs.q: Can you upgrade systems to support new machinery?
faqs.a: Absolutely, we assess load requirements and upgrade systems to safely support new equipment.

faqs.q: Do you offer emergency industrial electrical services?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide rapid-response industrial electrical services designed to get your facility back online as quickly and safely as possible.

faqs.q: Why choose Electrical Masters Company for industrial work?
faqs.a: Because we combine technical expertise, speed, and deep knowledge of compliance to keep your operations running safely and efficiently.

facts.heading: Generator options
items: Portable generators are a simple choice for short outages. They can power basic items like lights or a refrigerator, but they need to be set up manually.
Standby generators are installed outside your property and turn on automatically. These can power most or all of your space.
Solar generators use stored energy from the sun, which is a cleaner option but may have limited power.
Generac standby generators installed for Houston homes and businesses — automatic backup power that turns on within seconds of an outage.
